aboutCompany.title: A 3-Generation Family Enterprise Delivering Excellence
aboutCompany.paragraph1: Starting fresh produce cultivation in 1945, our company has steadily expanded production capacity and quality over more than 70 years, thriving as a third-generation family business.
aboutCompany.paragraph2: Building upon our domestic reputation in the 1980s, Meypal expanded exports across the Middle East and Balkans, moving into Russia and European markets in the 1990s. Since the early 2000s, our seasoned team has managed year-round export operations sourced from premier agricultural regions across Turkey.

hero.title: 70 Years of Trust and Export Excellence From Nature to Table
hero.description: Starting our production journey in 1945, today we operate a comprehensive global supply network based in Turkey and the United Kingdom. Delivering produce with day-one freshness to tables worldwide 12 months a year.

story.title: A Journey of Excellence from Soil to Global Markets
story.paragraph1: Starting fresh fruit and vegetable production in 1945, our company continues its operations as a third-generation family business, continuously enhancing its production capacity and product quality with over 70 years of experience.
story.paragraph2: Transforming its domestic market success into export excellence during the 1980s, primarily to the Middle East and Balkan countries, our company expanded this network to Russia and European countries from the 1990s onward. By the early 2000s, with an experienced team, it became a leading enterprise conducting export operations 12 months a year across every corner of Turkey.

readyToEat.title: Ready to Eat Products
readyToEat.subtitle: High-efficiency, fresh, and convenient solutions for the processing industry and convenience market
readyToEat.intro: As a market leader in lettuce, Meypal is positioned right at the heart of the convenience market and maintains close contact with the processing industry. We work in close cooperation with all stakeholders in our business field, treating their challenges as our own to devise solution strategies and introduce new products. Our primary aim in developing specialized breeding programs is achieving long shelf life, vibrant color, and superior taste.

items.title: Convenience Market & Processing Industry
items.description: As a market leader in lettuce, Meypal is positioned right at the heart of the convenience market and maintains close contact with the processing industry. We work in close cooperation with all stakeholders in our business field, treating their challenges as our own to devise solution strategies and introduce new products. Our primary aim in developing specialized breeding programs is achieving long shelf life, vibrant color, and superior taste.
items.imageAlt: Meypal fresh greens and vegetable processing preparation
items.highlight: Long shelf life, vibrant natural colors, and top-tier taste standards

items.title: Specific Attributes & High Profitability
items.description: For this industry, attractive appearance and great flavor alone are not enough. Among numerous specific demands, minimal waste during packaging, excellent presentation, and extended shelf life are of utmost importance. Growers' expectations for high yield and lower labor requirements are equally met. Meypal’s diverse range of vegetables allows processing companies and growers alike to maximize profitability.
items.imageAlt: Ready to eat packaged fresh salad and vegetables bowl
items.highlight: Low packaging waste, pristine presentation, and optimal shelf life

items.title: Cooperation & Strong Partnerships
items.description: Selecting the right variety demands close collaboration. Beyond the intrinsic traits of the crop, fertilization and irrigation conditions play a vital role in delivering a successful end-consumer product. Additionally, washability, processability, and storage stability are indispensable requirements. This is where our knowledge sharing with partners takes center stage—the definitive way to achieve optimal results from every variety. To anticipate demands from global markets, we maintain ongoing ties and joint projects with international convenience food specialists.
items.imageAlt: Salanova convenient fresh lettuce leaves emblem
items.highlight: Optimized washability, processability, and cold storage resilience

items.title: Proven Success: Salanova® & Caribbean Melon
items.description: In the convenience food category, Salanova® exemplifies a standout lettuce variety that separates into countless individual leaves with a single cut. Another highlight is the Caribbean Cantaloupe melon, featuring enhanced shelf life. Its thin, smooth rind and compact seed cavity make it exceptionally attractive for the processing sector. With mechanical lettuce harvesting becoming standard, manual factory cutting is obsolete. Our sweet, crisp varieties are perfectly suited for automated processing.
items.highlight: Single-cut Salanova® and high-yield, long shelf life Caribbean melon

contactCta.title: Custom Solutions for the Processing Industry
contactCta.description: Get in touch with our technical team to discuss specialized varieties and partnership opportunities for your convenience and food processing operations.

organic.intro: Since 1992, we have been working tirelessly to meet all organic seed requirements and offer a wide range of organically produced vegetable seeds recognized by all European certification bodies. We continuously strive to expand our product diversity without pause.

dedication.title: Dedicated Commitment to Organic Farming & Resilience
dedication.description: At Meypal, we believe organic farming deserves special attention and care. It is essential to remember that organic cultivation demands robust resilience, while meeting diverse consumer preferences requires a comprehensive variety. For this reason, our plant breeders pursue dedicated programs catering specifically to the needs of this target audience.

items.title: Dedicated Demo Fields & Greenhouses
items.description: We develop and meticulously test high-quality vegetable seeds in demo fields and greenhouses exclusively allocated for organic production.

items.title: Pest Resistance & Extended Shelf Life

items.title: Strict Regulatory Compliance

varieties.title: Chemical-Free Seed Diversity
varieties.description: Our organic seed range encompasses lettuce, tomato, cucumber, melon, chicory, and pepper seeds. Meypal pursues an extensive program to further expand this broad variety.
varieties.listSubtitle: Pure, natural, and high-performance vegetable varieties
varieties.preservationNote: Vegetables preserved properly shortly after harvest maintain nature's abundance at its best. Frozen, canned, or dried vegetables enable accessible, versatile, easy-to-prepare, and healthy meals at affordable prices. That is precisely why Meypal supports this industry with optimal varieties.

features.title: Open Field Adaptation & Quality Standards
features.intro: The vegetable industry utilizes 100% open field crops. The foremost attributes of our varieties are high resilience to diseases and rapid adaptation to diverse field conditions with premium quality.

items.title: High Yield & Climate Resilience
items.description: Exceptional resistance to harsh weather conditions, prolonged harvest periods, and seamless adaptability to varying field conditions.

items.title: Mechanical Harvesting & Shelf Life
items.description: Extended post-harvest shelf life, full suitability for mechanical harvesting, and superior internal product quality that grows ever more vital.

partnership.title: Collaborative System & Growing Diversity
partnership.description: Industrial vegetables represent an essential category for retail markets, food service, and food processing industries. partnership.futureGoal: Our goal at Meypal is to enrich our portfolio with more vegetable varieties and constantly enhance utilization opportunities. Together with our partners, we strive to deliver crops that best satisfy consumer needs post-processing.

excitingFlavors.subtitle: Extraordinary flavors, unique varieties, and healthy vegetable snacks based on extensive sensory research
excitingFlavors.intro: Meypal believes that extraordinary flavors deserve greater attention. Based on extensive sensory and consumer research, Meypal has selected a range of varieties for you that guarantee a truly distinctive taste experience.

items.title: Uniqueness & Exceptional Taste Experience
items.description: While flavor has always been of paramount importance in Meypal's breeding philosophy, our Exciting Flavors range stands out with its distinct varieties. For instance, a tomato with a surprising sweet-and-sour balance or an eggplant that absorbs less oil is cut out for frying. orange.aboutParagraph1: Orange is a universally cherished fruit and an indispensable staple on dining tables worldwide. Belonging to the citrus family, in Turkey it is primarily grown in fertile provinces governed by the Mediterranean climate such as Adana, Mersin, Dörtyol, and Antalya. Highly juicy and flavourful, the orange peel is not only prized for jams and marmalades, but is also widely utilized in aromatherapy, cologne, and perfume manufacturing.
orange.aboutParagraph2: To enjoy the extensive health benefits of freshly squeezed orange juice, it should be consumed freshly pressed right after harvest. The naturally occurring active nutrients and antioxidants deliver maximum bio-availability when freshness is preserved.
orange.aboutParagraph3: The human body cannot structurally synthesize or store its daily requirement of Vitamin C. Therefore, this vital nutrient must be regularly replenished through fresh dietary sources. For anyone seeking to bolster their immune defense naturally and meet daily vitamin requirements, orange is the foremost choice. Meypal oranges are an exceptional source of Vitamin C and vital mineral compositions.
orange.quote: Freshly squeezed Mediterranean orange: nature's purest way to energize your morning and strengthen immune vitality.

gallery.freshOrangesAlt: Meypal premium grade fresh Mediterranean oranges
gallery.juicingOrangesAlt: Juicy fresh oranges selected for juicing and table consumption
gallery.orchardHarvestAlt: Fresh orange harvesting in Mediterranean citrus groves

vitaminC.title: Rich Vitamin C Source
vitaminC.description: Naturally fulfills daily Vitamin C requirements, reinforces immune defenses, and acts as a powerful antioxidant shield.

climate.title: Ideal Mediterranean Climate
climate.description: Naturally ripens under the abundant sunshine and fertile soil of Mersin and Çukurova with an optimal sugar-to-acid ratio.

juicy.title: High Juice Yield
juicy.description: Thin-skinned, fleshy, and highly juicy varieties calibrated for both fresh table consumption and industrial juicing.

versatile.title: Versatile Usage
versatile.description: Beyond fresh fruit and juice, its aromatic peel is utilized in confectionery, marmalades, and natural essential oils.

mandarin.aboutParagraph1: Mandarin is a distinguished fruit belonging to the citrus family that flourishes in the temperate Mediterranean basin. Boasting vibrant yellow, orange, and red tones, mandarins are delightfully juicy, tender, and deeply aromatic.
mandarin.aboutParagraph2: Featuring a softer texture and thinner skin compared to oranges, mandarins peel effortlessly by hand for wholesome fresh snacking, and can also be pressed into refreshing, vitamin-rich citrus juice. In Turkey, they are cultivated to superior quality across the fertile coastal plains of the Aegean and Mediterranean.
mandarin.aboutParagraph3: Meypal delivers a comprehensive portfolio of premier mandarin varieties spanning from early-season harvests to late-ripening selections, meeting rigorous international hygiene and freshness benchmarks. Discover our cultivated varieties in detail below.
mandarin.quote: A sun-drenched Mediterranean delight: with its effortlessly peelable rind and vibrant citrus sweetness, mandarin is nature's finest healthy snack.

intro.title: Mandarin Varieties
intro.description: Cultivated across the fertile groves of the Mediterranean and Aegean under Meypal quality assurance, from early harvest to late-season varieties.

ellendale.name: Ellendale
ellendale.description: Produces exceptionally large and high-quality fruit. Aromatic, remarkably juicy, and flavourful with an ideal sugar-to-acid balance. Harvested between February and March, it stays resilient on the tree for extended periods and excels in commercial cold storage and global transport.

dobashi.name: Dobashi
dobashi.description: Grown on robust trees known as one of the most cold-hardy citrus varieties. An early-season variety with thin skin, firm texture, and outstanding flavor profile. Highly productive and well-suited for long-distance transport and commercial storage.

robinson.name: Robinson
robinson.description: Trees feature thornless branches with broad, spear-shaped leaves. Fruits possess a thin, smooth skin that peels easily. High-quality, juicy pulp with exceptional taste. Outstanding suitability for commercial handling and shipping.

lee.name: Lee
lee.description: Distinguished by thin, deep reddish-orange skin and a round shape. Highly crisp, sweetly fragrant, and tenderly delicious, making it a favorite for fresh table consumption.

sanburst.name: Sanburst
sanburst.description: Cultivated on large trees with early-season harvest characteristics. Flattened fruits with vibrant reddish-orange rinds, deep colored flesh, and abundant juice. Ripens steadily from mid-November through mid-December.

fremont.name: Fremont
fremont.description: Medium-vigor trees with upright growth and early fruiting traits. The fruit features a bright reddish-orange, smooth, and glossy peel. Highly aromatic and round, with excellent resilience in storage and transit.

satsuma.name: Satsuma
satsuma.description: The most widely celebrated mandarin across the Mediterranean basin. An exceptionally high-yielding early variety. Features thin, easily peelable skin, virtually seedless segments, and intense natural fragrance. Harvest spans late September through early October.

okitsu.name: Okitsu
okitsu.description: One of the earliest ripening mandarin varieties, harvesting about two weeks ahead of standard Satsuma. Produces large, slightly flattened, seedless, and wonderfully sweet fruit that peels with ease and stores well.

wMurcott.name: W. Murcott
wMurcott.description: Features a deep orange-reddish skin and brilliant orange interior. A celebrated late-season variety maturing from February through March. Known for its distinct fragrance and exceptionally sweet taste.

nova.name: Nova
nova.description: Thrives on large, vigorous trees with glossy foliage. Delivers superior fruit quality, large calibre, and intensely pleasant flavor. A very high-yielding variety harvested through November and December.

orri.name: Orri
orri.description: A high-end mandarin variety with bright orange, lustrous rind and extraordinarily juicy pulp. Harvested from February to April, it boasts very low acidity, high sugar content, and exceptional peelability at an average weight of 120 grams.

murcott.name: Murcott
murcott.description: Features a reddish-orange peel and bright, radiant segments. A late-ripening variety harvested during February and March, renowned for its lingering fragrant bouquet and sweet juiciness.

vitaminC.title: Natural Vitamin C Reservoir
vitaminC.description: High Vitamin C concentration fortifies immune defenses, serving as vital nutritional support during cold winter months.

climate.title: Mediterranean & Aegean Basins
climate.description: Ripens under generous sunshine in fertile coastal soils to achieve its pinnacle sweetness, aroma, and delicate skin.

sweet.title: Optimal Sugar-Acid Balance
sweet.description: Our select varieties offer low natural acidity paired with high soluble solids for an irresistibly refreshing taste.

easyPeel.title: Effortless Peeling & Seedless
easyPeel.description: Naturally thin and flexible rind that peels effortlessly by hand, making seedless segments the perfect wholesome snack.

lemon.aboutParagraph1: Lemon is an evergreen small tree species belonging to the citrus family, celebrated worldwide for its extraordinarily valuable, zesty, and aromatic fruit. In Turkey, it thrives under optimal agro-climatic conditions across the Mediterranean coastline, notably in Mersin, Erdemli, Silifke, and the fertile Çukurova delta.
lemon.aboutParagraph2: Remarkably juicy, with vibrant yellow skin and a high natural acidity level, lemon is an abundant source of Vitamin C. It serves as both an essential culinary accent for beverages, salads, and gourmet cuisines, as well as an indispensable raw material for modern food and cosmetic industries.
lemon.aboutParagraph3: Meypal grades and packages Turkey's premier early-season and late-season storage lemon varieties according to strict international quality standards. With our seamless cold-chain logistics, we deliver first-class freshness to global destinations throughout the year. Explore our featured lemon varieties below.
lemon.quote: Pure vitality from the fertile Mediterranean: with its high natural acidity, abundant juice, and exhilarating aroma, lemon is nature's strongest citrus essence.

intro.title: Lemon Varieties
intro.description: Grown under Meypal quality standards across the sunlit groves of the Mediterranean, from early-harvest varieties to long-storing winter selections.

enterdonat.name: Enterdonat
enterdonat.description: The earliest maturing lemon variety, Enterdonat is predominantly cultivated in Turkey's Eastern Mediterranean region. Turkey leads worldwide production with over 450,000 tons. The fruit is large, elongated, and cylindrical, characterized by its distinctly slanted nipple. The peel is smooth, light green, and shiny, while the pale greenish-yellow pulp has very few seeds. Being an early variety, it is ideal for fresh consumption rather than long storage. The export season spans September through December.

kutdiken.name: Kutdiken
kutdiken.description: The oldest and most extensively grown and stored lemon variety in Turkey. Possesses exceptional fruit quality with a smooth, glossy, tightly adhering lemon-yellow rind. The fruit is elliptic, seeded, exceptionally juicy, and highly acidic. Trees demonstrate high vigor, regular fruiting, and well-balanced fruit distribution across the canopy. A premier mid-season variety perfect for extended cold storage.

kibris.name: Cyprus Lemon
kibris.description: Commonly cultivated in the Alanya and Anamur regions, believed to have been introduced from Cyprus in the 1920s. Features a vibrant yellow, shiny, wavy peel of 5.24 mm thickness. The fruit is oval-cylindrical with a distinct neck at the stem and a nearly absent nipple, which is its defining physical trait. Boasts an acidity level of 7-10% and high tree productivity. Fruits ripen from mid-November onwards.

lizbon.name: Lisbon
lizbon.description: Highly prized across global markets, Lisbon lemon trees are vigorous, hardy, and productive. The fruit is juicy, high in citric acidity, with a smooth yellow peel and intense aroma. Highly suitable for fresh table consumption and international transport.

mayer.name: Meyer
mayer.description: Distinct from other lemons by its compact tree stature (up to 2.5–3 meters) and prolific year-round fruiting habit. Meyer lemons are considerably more cold-tolerant than standard varieties and thrive in sunny, moderate climates. The fruit carries a distinct, sweeter aroma reminiscent of an orange-lemon hybrid. Young trees begin bearing fruit just one year after planting.

misket.name: Lime (Misket)
misket.description: Known as green lemon or Lime in Turkey. Celebrated for its unique, zesty, and intensely fragrant profile, lime is the undisputed choice for premium cocktails like mojitos, refreshing beverages, citrus marinades, gourmet dressings, and desserts.

mollaMehmet.name: Molla Mehmet
mollaMehmet.description: An important native lemon variety widely grown across the Mersin region. Features yellow fruit with medium rind thickness and a distinct neck at the stem end. Has a titratable acidity of 6-10% and notable natural resistance against Mal Secco (Phoma tracheiphila). Regular bearing with high yields.

gallery.citrusGroveAlt: Meypal first-class export quality fresh citrus fruit

vitaminC.title: Maximum Vitamin C
vitaminC.description: Provides abundant natural Vitamin C and antioxidant flavonoids to support immune defenses year-round.

climate.title: Mersin & Mediterranean Microclimate
climate.description: Nurtured in the coastal microclimate of Mersin and Çukurova, achieving optimal rind luster and pulp texture.

acidity.title: High Acidity & Juice Yield
acidity.description: Delivers superior juice extract and a balanced 6-10% natural acidity, highly sought after in gastronomy and beverages.

exportStorage.title: Long Storage & Reliable Export
exportStorage.description: Varieties like Kutdiken endure long cold-storage periods without flavor loss, ensuring reliable 12-month international export.

grapefruit.aboutParagraph1: With its thick, light-yellow rind and vibrant segments that resemble an orange in appearance, grapefruit offers a distinctly different, invigorating citrus flavor. Juicy and succulent, grapefruit can present either white or intense red internal flesh. While some varieties grow seedless, others contain delicate small seeds.
grapefruit.aboutParagraph2: Exceptionally rich in dietary fiber, grapefruit is packed with a multitude of essential vitamins, nutrients, and minerals, as well as beneficial essential oils. Containing pantothenic acid, thiamine, niacin, and pyridoxine, along with vitamins A, E, C, and K, it stands as an outstanding natural wellness choice. It also provides abundant calcium, iron, copper, phosphorus, selenium, and magnesium.
grapefruit.aboutParagraph3: Grapefruit leaves a crisp, refreshing, and subtly pleasant tangy finish on the palate. Removing the thin inner pith membranes further softens any natural bitterness. Meypal meticulously selects and packages premier Star Ruby and Riored grapefruit varieties from sunny Mediterranean groves to deliver peak freshness globally.
grapefruit.quote: Renowned for its robust vitamin profile, vibrant ruby hue, and invigorating zest, grapefruit is one of the Mediterranean's finest citrus treasures.

intro.title: Grapefruit Varieties
intro.description: Cultivated in the fertile soils of the Mediterranean basin under Meypal assurance: our vibrant red-fleshed Star Ruby and Riored grapefruit varieties.

starRuby.name: Star Ruby
starRuby.description: Star Ruby is a premier grapefruit variety celebrated for its rich red interior and blushing exterior. Maturing in November, it can remain on the tree for an extended period. With exceptional juiciness and radiant crimson pulp, it remains a global favorite in fresh markets.

riored.name: Riored
riored.description: Riored is favored for its well-rounded, uniform fruit shape, blushed rind, and deep red flesh. Harvested primarily in January and February, it stands out for its high caliber consistency and strong suitability for international export standards.

gallery.freshGrapefruitAlt: Meypal first-class fresh grapefruit from the branch
gallery.starRubyAlt: Fresh Star Ruby grapefruit with rich red pulp and skin
gallery.harvestAlt: Fresh grapefruit harvest in Meypal Mediterranean citrus groves

vitaminC.title: Vitamins A, C & K
vitaminC.description: Provides powerful immune and vitality support through vitamins A, E, C, and K, complemented by pantothenic acid, thiamine, and niacin.

climate.title: Mediterranean Sun
climate.description: Ripened under the abundant Mediterranean sunshine of Çukurova, achieving optimal flesh coloration, natural sweetness, and aroma.

antioxidant.title: Lycopene & Antioxidants
antioxidant.description: Rich in natural lycopene and bioflavonoids derived from its deep red segments, helping protect cellular health.

exportStorage.title: Long Shelf-Life & Export Durability
exportStorage.description: Maintains premium fruit firmness on tree and within modern temperature-controlled cold storage, ideal for international transit.

quince.aboutParagraph1: Quince is one of the most beloved and historically celebrated fruits across the Mediterranean and Anatolia, with a cultivation legacy dating back nearly 4,000 years. Its rich nutrients and wholesome qualities have supported human health and child immune development for generations.
quince.aboutParagraph2: With an exceptionally versatile culinary and aromatic profile, quince was even used in Roman times for crafting perfumes, essential oils, and infused honeys. While naturally firm and fiber-rich, quinces cultivated in warmer Mediterranean microclimates yield softer, juicier, and more succulent textures.
quince.aboutParagraph3: In Turkey, three principal varieties lead commercial production: Esme, Lemon, and Ekmek quince. Esme quince from the Marmara region is renowned for its juicy, pleasantly tart flavor. Ekmek quince features balanced sweetness, while Lemon quince provides refreshing tanginess. Meypal carefully sorts, sizes, and exports premier Turkish quinces worldwide.
quince.quote: With its 4,000-year heritage, heavenly floral fragrance, and golden perfection, Anatolian quince is nature's timeless gift of health.

gallery.freshQuinceAlt: Meypal premium first-class fresh golden quinces
gallery.slicedQuinceAlt: Meypal aromatic and juicy sliced quince

immune.title: Immune Defense & Pectin
immune.description: Rich in vitamin C, soluble pectin fiber, and protective polyphenols that support digestion and fortify natural immunity.

climate.title: Optimal Microclimate
climate.description: Nurtured under generous sunshine, developing balanced sugar-acid proportions, pleasant texture, and intense floral aroma.

aroma.title: Incomparable Fragrance
aroma.description: Celebrated for its distinct, perfume-like bouquet and pleasing tartness, prized in fresh dishes and gourmet culinary creations.

storage.title: Excellent Storage & Transit
storage.description: Naturally durable peel and modern temperature-controlled cold facilities ensure superior resilience during international shipping.

cherry.aboutParagraph1: Known scientifically as Prunus avium, sweet cherries are the crown jewel of early summer. Cherries are deeply cherished across tables worldwide—consumed fresh, in fruit platters, pressed into artisan juices, or made into exquisite gourmet preserves.
cherry.aboutParagraph2: Cultivated in fertile Anatolian valleys where microclimates allow optimal chilling hours and warm sun, Turkish cherries boast unparalleled quality. Looking at international production and export rankings, Turkey proudly stands at the very forefront of the global cherry industry.
cherry.aboutParagraph3: Among world-famous varieties, 0900 Ziraat (Turkish Napoleon) leads with its large caliber, crunchy flesh, deep ruby-black color, and resilient shelf life. Meypal manages a complete cold chain with rapid hydrocooling, ensuring cherries retain orchard-crisp freshness across international borders.
cherry.quote: Ripened under the fertile sun of Turkey, our premium sweet cherries offer unmatched firmness, size, and rich flavor admired worldwide.

gallery.freshCherriesAlt: Meypal first-class fresh dark red cherries
gallery.crateCherriesAlt: Carefully calibrated and packed Turkish cherries for export

antioxidant.title: Anthocyanins & Antioxidants
antioxidant.description: Packed with potent anthocyanin antioxidants and natural melatonin, promoting cellular longevity and restful sleep.

exportLeader.title: World-Leading Export Quality
exportLeader.description: Sourced from Turkey's renowned cherry orchards adhering to strict GlobalGAP and international caliber certifications.

firmJuicy.title: Crunchy Texture & High Caliber
firmJuicy.description: Delivers satisfying crunch, high brix sweetness, and exceptional sizing that fulfill the highest culinary standards.

coldChain.title: Unbroken Hydrocooled Cold Chain
coldChain.description: Immediate post-harvest hydrocooling and controlled-atmosphere transport preserve stem greenness and fruit firmness to the destination.

fig.aboutParagraph1: The fig (Ficus carica), native to the Eastern Mediterranean and Southwest Asia, is among the most ancient cultivated fruit trees in human civilization. Celebrated for its unique jammy texture, floral aroma, and honeyed flavor, it holds a prestigious place among premium seasonal fruits.
fig.aboutParagraph2: Fresh black figs are packed with bioavailable calcium, potassium, magnesium, and dietary fiber. Meypal unites modern production and distribution guarantees with the authentic heritage of traditional Mediterranean horticulture.
fig.aboutParagraph3: Handling delicate transit needs with advanced protective packaging and precision temperature control, Meypal selects the finest purple-black Mediterranean figs for seamless worldwide air and land export.
fig.quote: A timeless treasure of Mediterranean heritage, the black fig enchants with its honeyed richness, silky texture, and pure wholesome vitality.

gallery.freshFigsAlt: Meypal premium fresh dark purple black figs
gallery.slicedFigAlt: Meypal luscious open fresh fig showing vibrant pulp

nutritional.title: Rich in Calcium & Potassium
nutritional.description: Delivers notable amounts of vital minerals including calcium, iron, and potassium to support cardiovascular and bone health.

mediterranean.title: Authentic Mediterranean Origin
mediterranean.description: Cultivated in indigenous Mediterranean soil conditions where ideal dry warmth promotes maximum natural sugars.

fiber.title: High Prebiotic Soluble Fiber
fiber.description: Contains gentle, soluble pectin and dietary fibers that nourish gut health and aid everyday digestion.

premiumExport.title: Dedicated Packaging & Air Freight
premiumExport.description: Cradled in protective trays and swift cold-chain transport channels to guarantee peak freshness upon arrival.

peach.aboutParagraph1: Meypal delivers an expansive selection of both round peaches and flat Ufo peaches year after year. Our program guarantees exceptional flavor, high sugar brix, firm export durability, and resistance to post-harvest handling.
peach.aboutParagraph2: Bathed in the warm sun of Mediterranean and Aegean valleys, peach orchards achieve generous fruit size, velvety skins, and juicy flesh. Whether yellow or white fleshed, their aromatic succulence makes them a worldwide summer favorite.
peach.aboutParagraph3: Alongside classic round varieties such as Flodasun, Early Amber, Redhaven, and Washington, our sweet flat Ufo peaches continue to delight modern retail and food service markets with effortless eating quality and sweet fragrance.
peach.quote: Kissed by the Mediterranean sunshine, our peaches and Ufo flat peaches deliver unmatched juiciness, sweetness, and velvety perfection.

intro.title: Peach Varieties
intro.description: High-yielding, succulent, and fragrant peach varieties harvested across early, mid, and late seasons with Meypal quality assurance.

flodasun.name: Flodasun
flodasun.description: Semi-upright vigorous tree maturing in late May in the Mediterranean. Averages 120g with juicy yellow flesh and high orchard yield.

earlyAmber.name: Early Amber
earlyAmber.description: Spreading tree structure ripening in late May. Averages 150g with sweet yellow flesh, ideal for coastal Mediterranean climates.

springtime.name: Springtime
springtime.description: Flat-rounded shape averaging 90g with red blush over yellow ground. Tender white juicy flesh with refreshing sweet flavor.

precocissima.name: Precocissima
precocissima.description: Upright vigorous tree ripening early. Averages 100g with intense dark red coloration, greenish-white flesh, and pleasant tartness.

earlyRed.name: Early Red
earlyRed.description: Vigorous and highly productive tree. Averages 125g, dark red over yellow, with fine-grained sweet flesh and rich aroma.

blazingGold.name: Blazing Gold
blazingGold.description: Averages 143g with vibrant red blush over golden-yellow skin. Features yellow, aromatic, and fine-textured sweet flesh.

merrillGemFree.name: Merrill Gem Free
merrillGemFree.description: Averages 197g large caliber, dark red striped, with firm yellow flesh and high resilience against late spring frosts.

cardinal.name: Cardinal
cardinal.description: Averages 161g with uniform red skin over deep yellow ground. Fine texture and balanced sweetness, well suited for Mediterranean valleys.

dixired.name: Dixired
dixired.description: Averages 175g with dark red marbling on yellow base. Low-fiber, moderately juicy, and aromatic sweet flesh.

starkingDelicious.name: Starking Delicious
starkingDelicious.description: Averages 184g, slightly elongated with light red mottling on yellow-green ground. Moderately juicy, sweet, and aromatic.

coronet.name: Coronet
coronet.description: Averages 156g with bright red coloration over yellow ground. Freestone characteristic with excellent shipping and transit durability.

redhaven.name: Redhaven (R-1)
redhaven.description: A benchmark variety averaging 185g with dark red blush, melting yellow sweet flesh, freestone separation, and high transit firmness.

washington.name: Washington
washington.description: Exceptional size averaging 208g with deep red blush, aromatic yellow flesh, freestone seed, and strong cold hardiness.

sweetJuicy.title: Supreme Juiciness & Succulence
sweetJuicy.description: High juice yield and pleasant natural acidity balance make these peaches highly sought after for both table and gourmet use.

transport.title: Engineered for Long Transit
transport.description: Sized and packed with modern cushioning technology to preserve firm skin and optimal condition during long-haul transport.

pomegranate.aboutParagraph1: At Meypal, we uphold uncompromising standards of natural authenticity and supreme fruit quality. The pomegranate (Punica granatum), belonging to the Lythraceae family, is an ancient sacred fruit composed of hundreds of vibrant ruby arils encased in a crowned protective rind.
pomegranate.aboutParagraph2: A 100g serving delivers concentrated antioxidant punicalagins, vitamins C and K, essential potassium, and beneficial dietary fibers. Balanced in caloric profile, pomegranates are completely cholesterol-free and virtually free of saturated fats, acting as a natural vitality elixir.
pomegranate.aboutParagraph3: Representing the largest share of Turkish pomegranate exports, the certified Hicaz pomegranate is globally acclaimed for its deep ruby arils, harmonious sweet-tart flavor balance, large fruit size, and extraordinary capability to store for up to 6 months in cold storage without quality loss.
pomegranate.quote: With its jewel-like ruby arils, signature sweet-tart aroma, and profound antioxidant vitality, Hicaz pomegranate embodies Mediterranean abundance.

intro.title: Pomegranate Varieties
intro.description: Certified and world-leading Turkish Hicaz pomegranate cultivated with supreme agricultural care.

hicazNar.name: Hicaz Pomegranate
hicazNar.description: Registered by Antalya West Mediterranean Agricultural Research Institute (BATEM). The flagship of Turkish fruit exports, featuring dark red skin, intense ruby arils, balanced acidity, and unmatched 6-month cold storage durability.

antioxidant.title: Punicalagins & Vitamin C
antioxidant.description: Packed with concentrated polyphenolic antioxidants that combat oxidative stress and promote cardiovascular longevity.

climate.title: Mediterranean Microclimate
climate.description: Nurtured in fertile valleys with abundant sunshine and mild autumns, securing intense skin color and optimal sweet-tart brix.

tartSweet.title: Signature Sweet-Tart Harmony
tartSweet.description: Neither overly acidic nor sugary, its nuanced flavor profile is the premier choice for table use, culinary dressings, and juicing.

storage.title: 6 Months Storage Longevity
storage.description: Durable, thick protective rind permits up to 6 months of flawless preservation under precision controlled-atmosphere storage.

grape.aboutParagraph1: Grapes stand among the most ancient cultivated treasures of Anatolia and the Mediterranean—the historical cradle of viticulture. Meypal delivers fresh table grape varieties that bring together high orchard yield, large berry caliber, high natural brix, and transit resilience.
grape.aboutParagraph2: Our export-grade table grapes feature generous, well-formed bunches with firm, conical, fleshy berries. Rich in natural fructose, potassium, and protective grape polyphenols including resveratrol, they provide immediate revitalizing nourishment.
grape.aboutParagraph3: Renowned varieties including Pembe Gemre, classic table Super Asma, and early-ripening Trakya Ilkeren maintain exceptional berry attachment and freshness post-harvest. Meypal packs each bunch with care in specialized ventilated packaging for dependable worldwide transit.
grape.quote: Rooted in thousands of years of Anatolian viticulture, our crisp, sweet, and sun-kissed table grapes bring timeless vineyard flavor to world tables.

intro.title: Table Grape Varieties
intro.description: High-yielding, resilient, and exquisitely flavored table grape varieties spanning early to late harvest windows.

pembeGemre.name: Pembe Gemre
pembeGemre.description: Features large, moderately dense clusters with attractive pinkish-red berries. Ripening in September, this high-yielding variety is widely celebrated for table consumption.

superAsma.name: Super Asma Table Grape
superAsma.description: The quintessential Turkish table grape. Large bunches with tightly packed, slightly oval, golden-yellow-green berries maturing in August with honeyed sweetness.

trakyaIlkeren.name: Trakya Ilkeren
trakyaIlkeren.description: Produces substantial, heavy clusters with fleshy conical berries. Reaches early maturity while retaining outstanding freshness on the vine and during transport.

gallery.freshGrapesAlt: Meypal premium first-class fresh table grapes
gallery.bunchGrapesAlt: Freshly harvested large grape clusters from sunny vineyards

antioxidant.title: Resveratrol & Flavonoids
antioxidant.description: Abundant in natural trans-resveratrol and anthocyanins located in the skin, delivering powerful cellular and cardiovascular defense.

climate.title: Sunny Anatolian Slopes
climate.description: Cultivated on sun-drenched terraced slopes where daytime heat and nighttime breezes produce firm skins and elevated sugar levels.

sweetJuicy.title: Crisp Berry Texture & High Brix
sweetJuicy.description: Exhibits a refreshing crunch, luscious juice release, and clean natural sweetness beloved across international markets.

storage.title: Non-Shattering Durable Bunches
storage.description: Strong pedicel attachment and thick skins protect against shatter and moisture loss across extended transit routes.

apricot.aboutParagraph1: Apricot (Prunus armeniaca), belonging to the Rosaceae family, is one of the most delicate and treasured stone fruits cultivated across Anatolia. Slightly larger than a walnut, fresh apricots gleam with golden-yellow to deep velvety orange hues and offer fragrant tenderness.
apricot.aboutParagraph2: Abundant in provitamin A (beta-carotene), vitamin C, and dietary potassium, fresh apricots fortify eyesight, skin elasticity, and daily digestive vitality. Their cleanly separating freestone pit makes table consumption effortless and enjoyable.
apricot.aboutParagraph3: Meypal sources world-famous varieties including Hasanbey, Hacihaliloglu, Alyanak, and Salak (Aprikoz) directly from premier Malatya and Mediterranean groves. Packed in protective cushioned punnets, our fresh apricots travel swiftly under cold-chain conditions.
apricot.quote: Basked in golden sunlight, our velvety fresh Anatolian apricots captivate with honeyed sweetness, silky texture, and unmistakable floral fragrance.

intro.title: Apricot Varieties
intro.description: Internationally renowned table and dried apricot selections from Malatya and Mediterranean orchards.

hasanbey.name: Hasanbey Apricot
hasanbey.description: Malatya's undisputed queen of table apricots. Exceptional fruit size, juicy honeyed pulp, and golden-orange skin deliver an unforgettable fresh eating experience.

hacihaliloglu.name: Hacihaliloglu Apricot
hacihaliloglu.description: The world-famous benchmark for flavor and sugar concentration. Exceptionally rich dry matter and sweet aromatic pulp prize it for dual table and drying use.

alyanak.name: Alyanak & Salak (Aprikoz)
alyanak.description: Characterized by radiant crimson-blushed cheeks, extra-large sizing, and balanced sweet-tart juiciness highly requested in international fresh markets.

gallery.ripeApricotsAlt: Meypal juicy and aromatic ripe fresh apricots

vitamins.title: Rich in Beta-Carotene (Vitamin A)
vitamins.description: Packed with provitamin A carotenoids, vitamin C, and potassium that support visual acuity, skin health, and immune vitality.

climate.title: Microclimatic Valley Sunlight
climate.description: Harvested in sheltered valley basins featuring sharp day-night temperature swings that concentrate rich natural fruit sugars.

sweetJuicy.title: Melting Pulp & Floral Fragrance
sweetJuicy.description: Velvety skin encasing tender, honey-sweet flesh makes fresh apricots an irresistible seasonal delicacy.

exportStorage.title: Cushioned Punnet Transit
exportStorage.description: Safeguarded within custom-molded clamshells and rapid temperature-controlled transit to preclude bruising and preserve firmness.

watermelon.aboutParagraph1: Watermelon (Citrullus lanatus) is a beloved annual vine belonging to the Cucurbitaceae family, celebrated for its refreshing crispness and sweet scarlet flesh. Holding deep historical roots in Mediterranean and Anatolian summer tables, it is the ultimate symbol of cooling hydration.
watermelon.aboutParagraph2: Composed of 92% natural water enriched with electrolytes and potent lycopene—in concentrations exceeding even fresh tomatoes—watermelon provides clean, revitalizing hydration with remarkably low calories, zero fat, and pure wholesome pleasure.
watermelon.aboutParagraph3: Meypal excels in both classic large Crimson Sweet field watermelons and convenient, refrigerator-friendly, seedless Sugar Baby personal melons. Sized with precision and tested for brix sweetness, our watermelons reach global retailers in pristine condition.
watermelon.quote: Sun-ripened in Mediterranean soils, our crisp, sweet, and bursting watermelons offer nature's purest hydration and summer delight.

intro.title: Watermelon Varieties
intro.description: From substantial striped family-size cultivars to modern personal snack watermelons.

crimsonSweet.name: Crimson Sweet
crimsonSweet.description: Recognized by prominent dark and light green striping, dense scarlet flesh, and high sugar brix. The international standard for large family-size summer watermelons.

sugarBaby.name: Sugar Baby
sugarBaby.description: Solid dark green rind with micro-seeds or seedless genetics. Convenient personal sizing tailored for modern convenience and small household refrigerators.

lycopene.title: High Bioactive Lycopene
lycopene.description: Imparts vibrant crimson flesh with concentrated lycopene and L-citrulline, aiding vascular health and post-exercise recovery.

climate.title: Deep Çukurova Soils
climate.description: Thrives under intense Mediterranean sunlight in fertile alluvial soils to yield dense cell structure and balanced sweetness.

hydration.title: 92% Natural Hydration
hydration.description: Supplies pure botanical water combined with potassium and magnesium to restore bodily fluid balance during summer heat.

convenience.title: Robust Rind & Modern Sizing
convenience.description: Features resilient rind thickness that resists transit compression, ideal for containerized pallet freight.

melon.aboutParagraph1: Melon (Cucumis melo) represents one of the fastest-growing categories in the Meypal fresh produce catalog. Through continuous breeding partnerships worldwide, Meypal has perfected an all-year melon program characterized by uncompromising quality and sweetness.
melon.aboutParagraph2: Innovation drives Meypal forward. The Caribbean melon family leads modern melon breeding, offering fragrant golden-orange flesh, paper-thin rind, minimal seed cavity, and exceptional brix that redefine consumer convenience and gourmet presentation.
melon.aboutParagraph3: Because melons must travel long distances to global destinations, shelf life is of paramount importance. Meypal melons combine stable high yields and robust disease resistance with long-lasting post-harvest firmness, arriving tree-fresh across weeks of transit.
melon.quote: Our innovative Caribbean melon program redefines fresh melons with its thin rind, compact seed cavity, and luscious honeyed sweetness.

vitamins.title: Vitamins A, C & Folate
vitamins.description: Packed with bioavailable beta-carotene, vitamin C, and folate to bolster natural immunity and radiant cellular vitality.

climate.title: Mediterranean Sun & Warmth
climate.description: Maximizes natural photosynthesis during warm summer days to accumulate elevated brix sugar and intoxicating aroma.

aroma.title: Honeyed Bouquet & Silky Flesh
aroma.description: Delivers melt-in-the-mouth juiciness paired with room-filling musky fragrance prized in gourmet culinary settings.

shelfLife.title: Extended Shelf Life & Thin Rind
shelfLife.description: Small seed cavity and resilient external netting yield maximum edible portion and long-lasting export transit life.

citrus.title: Fresh & Aromatic Citrus Varieties
citrus.subtitle: Premium Citrus Ripened under Mediterranean Sunshine
citrus.description: Since 1945, Meypal carefully harvests oranges, mandarins, lemons, and grapefruits cultivated in the Mediterranean's most fertile orchards, processing them in modern calibration and cold storage facilities for worldwide export.

fruits.title: Mediterranean & Anatolian Fresh Fruits
fruits.subtitle: Sun-Ripened Quality and Natural Wholesome Flavor
fruits.description: Harvested from the most fertile orchards of Anatolia and the Mediterranean, Meypal brings quince, sweet cherry, black fig, peach, pomegranate, table grape, apricot, watermelon, and melon varieties to world markets with cutting-edge cold-chain logistics and quality standards.
